steps.en: The box is for Chef Dot.
The cake order is in the other box.

steps.en: The cart crossed before the bridge broke.
The child is safe with the cart driver.

chains.premise_ko: 회수한 책 속 편지의 수신인과 옛집을 찾는다.

steps.en: The letter was kept inside the book.
The old house is near the park.

chains.premise_ko: 옛집의 기록을 해독하고 소원 마을의 문양과 비교한다.

steps.en: The mark is on the old tablet.
The same mark is on the bird cage.

chains.dialogue_status: route outline; stage-specific dialogue and tasks pending

chains.premise_ko: 새 경주 상품이 잘못 배송되어 분실물 보관소까지 추적한다.

steps.en: The medal belongs to the winner.
The parcel was sent to Pronovia.

chains.dialogue_status: route outline; stage-specific dialogue and tasks pending

chains.premise_ko: 분실물 속 항해 지도와 여행 계획을 주인에게 돌려준다.

steps.en: The map is in the blue bag.
I need the map to reach the island.

chains.dialogue_status: route outline; stage-specific dialogue and tasks pending

chains.premise_ko: 여행자의 보고서에서 숲의 이상 현상과 축제 안전 문제를 조사한다.

steps.en: The noise made the horses run.
Do not use the forest road.

chains.dialogue_status: route outline; stage-specific dialogue and tasks pending

chains.premise_ko: 축제에 도착한 전갈의 진위를 확인하고 성문을 열 단서를 얻는다.

steps.en: The messenger said the seal was safe.
It was the silver key that opened the gate.
